actions.action: Separate private needs from published placements.
actions.mechanism: Generate a minimal public seating list from restricted operational records, excluding accommodation reasons and flags.
actions.implementation: Restrict the original spreadsheet to seating staff. Publish a separate values-only list of attendee identifiers, tables, and seats; collect placement needs without medical details.
actions.check: Using an attendee account, verify private records, comments, hidden columns, and revision history are inaccessible.
actions.risk: Previously shared copies may remain accessible.

actions.action: Allocate clear-route seats before pairing attendees.
actions.mechanism: Treat the four verified clear-route seats as eligibility constraints; optimize pair preferences only within feasible assignments.
actions.implementation: Mark all 48 seats across eight tables, identifying the four eligible seats. Assign hard needs first; flag excess demand as unresolved.
actions.check: Request five accessible placements: at most four receive eligible seats, and the fifth is explicitly unresolved, never assigned elsewhere.
actions.risk: A seat designation is invalid if its route becomes obstructed.

actions.action: Protect confirmed accessible placements during every update.
actions.mechanism: Lock confirmed accessible assignments so cancellations and preference changes cannot silently displace their occupants.
actions.implementation: Record confirmation and assignment versions. Preserve locks during recalculation; require documented attendee contact and another compliant placement before moving a confirmed occupant.
actions.check: Cancel another attendee and submit a conflicting pair request; verify the confirmed accessible assignment remains unchanged without documented contact.
actions.risk: Unreachable attendees leave proposed moves blocked, not automatically authorized.

actions.action: Offer separated seats for infeasible late pair requests.
actions.mechanism: Keep preference failures explicit while using cancellations to reconsider pairs without overriding hard needs or protected assignments.
actions.implementation: When only separated seats remain, offer them honestly. If accepted, record an unmet pair preference and recheck after cancellations until session start.
actions.check: With 46 seats occupied and two seats at different tables, request a pair: offer separated seats without displacing anyone.
actions.risk: Attendees may decline; never promise later adjacent seats.
